fusions.name: Barbed Withdrawal
fusions.desc: Tears the barb back out, dealing 8 damage and leaving the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Harpoon Line
fusions.desc: Throws a barbed harpoon that deals 13 damage to the first enemy it meets, stuns it for 1.2 seconds and leaves it [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Reel Them In
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 3 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Snagged Already
fusions.desc: You deal 10% more damage to enemies carrying your afflictions.
